testCase.name: [dev] S27 A delete is scoped to one chart: the same drug, task and point on another patient and in Nursing Home stay, and new dictation on other charts still creates the row

descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · TC-24 Deletions · S27 「删除只作用于一个病历：另一个病人和养老院里同样的药、任务和要点都留着，别的病历上的新口述照样建出这一行」 A delete is scoped to one chart: the same drug, task and point on another patient and in Nursing Home stay, and new dictation on other charts still creates the row

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 A deleted medication row, task or Important Point does not reappear on the next day's processing (or any later processing) unless the physician dictates it again.（UAT TC-24；TFA-94699 AC 5；TFA-92590 AC 5） — gate: blocked: TFA-94699 in progress
  • U10 Every TC-24 rule holds in both Hospital and Nursing Home, including deleting a Nursing Home resident.（UAT 3.3；UAT TC-24）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Fresh physician. The fixture Hospital patient, control 'QA Hosp Keep <tag>' and the Nursing Home resident each carry 'Metoprolol tartrate 25 mg PO BID', the task 'Call daughter re: goals of care' and the point 'Check heel ulcer dressing'. …

When On the fixture patient delete the row, the task and the point, then type a pre-round text and press Save Note. Check the control patient and the resident. Then dictate metoprolol on the two new charts (Save Note; Save & Extract).

Then The control patient and the resident still have all three items. Both new charts get a metoprolol row: the 'never comes back' rule is kept per chart, not per account, drug name or text.

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：TFA-94699 AC 5 and the 'data from another patient or context' risk (test-design §2). oracle.mjs: every control checkpoint must contain the item; the new charts must show their own metoprolol row. Row presence is read in the Medications editor ('Remove <name>' per row), where a course or medication-event panel cannot stand in for a row (oracleRules 2). …

在哪跑：dev；测试方法 AGENT · 浏览器 agent；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（automated）

S27 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/TC-24.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：dev — dev 部署，build e02167f（Deploy Convex，2026-10-12T18:24:27Z）；账号和地址不写进报告；run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev。

测试方法：AGENT · 浏览器 agent；辅助：API · 接口（Convex 函数） — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 both 跑；来源：dev。
